# Punkolink

> A cloud platform of five equal building blocks — Network, Executable, DRP, In-memory, and Database — that run on one platform and assemble into a stack. Every block runs on DRP (Docker Run Platform) and is billed by the minute in credits. Priced simply: credits at $1 each, 20 free to start, no card.

## The cloud

- [The Punkolink Cloud](https://punkolink.com/saas.html): The five building blocks in detail — Network (the Punkolink L7 router: routing, load balancing, layer-3 and layer-7 access control, rate limiting, bot and brute-force protection, availability monitoring, web GUI), Executable (bring a container image and run it), DRP (a supervised container, kept running and billed by the minute; also the runtime the other blocks are built on), In-memory (managed Valkey for caching, sessions, queues, and counters), and Database (managed Postgres with Apache AGE for graph, ParadeDB for search and analytics, and pgvector for embeddings).

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://punkolink.com/pricing.html): One thing to buy — credits, priced at $1 each, sold in packs of 5. 20 free credits on signup, no card. Credits are spent by the minute as blocks run; a DRP instance costs about 5 credits per month.
- [Pricing Policy](https://punkolink.com/legal/pricing-policy.html): The exact terms — a credit is a unit of account and prepayment for services, not a payment instrument, not e-money, not withdrawable. Per-minute rates, including the exact DRP rate, are set out here.
